background: UniCredit is Italy's second-largest bank and a leading lender in Germany, Austria and Central and Eastern Europe, funded by deposits across those markets, with a large stake in Commerzbank and a Russian subsidiary it has been winding down.
synthesis: UniCredit is rated A- on average across all three main agencies, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 25 Nov 2025. Capital is on the weak side of EU and Nordic banks and moving the wrong way: CET1 of 14.3% and leverage of 5.1% are both below the peer median, having fallen 1.8 points and 0.6 points since 30 Jun 2025. Liquidity is mixed, with NSFR of 124% above the peer median but LCR of 140% in the bottom quarter (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The only item flagged in the last 90 days, on 6 Aug 2026, concerns its tightening grip on Commerzbank, whose quarterly profit almost doubled.
